replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Your username is clearly objectional, there could be many players whose family has in one way or another been affected by the holocaust and you are just revindicating it with your username. I checked if it was only my thing, I made a poll within the staff and "inappropriate" won by a great difference.

I'm not going to unban you because you have never had any problems. I'll give you another option though. At this point you can:

 - Change your minecraft name.
 - Use another account to play Avicus (we allow ban evasion for inappropriate name bans).
 - Remain without playing

I'm sorry but you'll have to go through at least one of those paths. The unban is in your hands.
